name: gielinor-companion-mcp
description: An open-source, AI-compatible RuneScape 3 quest, levelling and Grand Exchange companion.

scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @gielinor/shared-types build && corepack pnpm --filter @gielinor/core build && corepack pnpm --filter @gielinor/providers build && corepack pnpm --filter @gielinor/database build && corepack pnpm --filter @gielinor/mcp-server build && corepack pnpm --filter @gielinor/hosted-server build && corepack pnpm --filter @gielinor/alt1-overlay build && corepack pnpm --filter @gielinor/agent-runtime build && corepack pnpm --filter @gielinor/desktop build && node scripts/verify-safety-boundary.mjs
scripts.test: corepack pnpm build && vitest run && corepack pnpm --filter @gielinor/desktop test
scripts.test:unit: corepack pnpm build && vitest run packages/core/test packages/providers/test packages/agent-runtime/test apps/mcp-server/test/schemas.test.ts
scripts.test:mcp: corepack pnpm build && vitest run apps/mcp-server/test
scripts.test:providers: corepack pnpm build && vitest run packages/providers/test
scripts.test:ai: corepack pnpm build && vitest run packages/agent-runtime/test
scripts.test:hosted: corepack pnpm build && vitest run apps/hosted-server/test
scripts.test:database: corepack pnpm build && vitest run packages/database/test
scripts.test:hardening: corepack pnpm build && vitest run packages/shared-types/test packages/providers/test/provider-plugin.test.ts packages/providers/test/cache.test.ts packages/core/test/data-migrations.test.ts packages/core/test/quest-service.test.ts packages/database/test apps/hosted-server/test/load.test.ts
scripts.test:errors: corepack pnpm --filter @gielinor/shared-types build && node scripts/generate-error-docs.mjs --check && vitest run packages/shared-types/test/errors.test.ts apps/mcp-server/test/schemas.test.ts apps/hosted-server/test/http-server.test.ts
scripts.test:resilience: corepack pnpm build && vitest run packages/shared-types/test/retry.test.ts packages/providers/test/http.test.ts packages/providers/test/circuit-breaker.test.ts packages/providers/test/cache.test.ts packages/core/test/health-service.test.ts
scripts.test:recovery: corepack pnpm build && vitest run packages/database/test/recovery.test.ts packages/database/test/scheduler.test.ts packages/database/test/diagnostics.test.ts apps/mcp-server/test/maintenance-runtime.test.ts apps/mcp-server/test/diagnostics-service.test.ts
scripts.test:scheduler: corepack pnpm build && vitest run packages/database/test/scheduler.test.ts apps/mcp-server/test/maintenance-runtime.test.ts && corepack pnpm --filter @gielinor/desktop exec vitest run src/views/FirstRunView.test.tsx
scripts.test:update-checker: corepack pnpm build && vitest run apps/mcp-server/test/update-service.test.ts apps/mcp-server/test/diagnostics-tools.integration.test.ts && corepack pnpm --filter @gielinor/desktop exec vitest run src/App.test.tsx -t "checks validated releases"
scripts.test:fault-injection: corepack pnpm build && vitest run packages/providers/test/http.test.ts packages/providers/test/jagex-providers.test.ts packages/providers/test/cache.test.ts packages/database/test/recovery.test.ts packages/database/test/scheduler.test.ts packages/core/test/data-migrations.test.ts apps/mcp-server/test/update-service.test.ts
scripts.test:release: corepack pnpm build && vitest run packages/shared-types/test/stable-contracts.test.ts packages/providers/test/stable-interface.test.ts packages/database/test/upgrade-path.test.ts && node scripts/verify-release.mjs
scripts.test:load: corepack pnpm build && vitest run packages/database/test/performance.test.ts apps/hosted-server/test/load.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: corepack pnpm build && vitest run apps/mcp-server/test/quest-flow.e2e.test.ts apps/mcp-server/test/levelling-flow.e2e.test.ts apps/mcp-server/test/grand-exchange-flow.e2e.test.ts && corepack pnpm --filter @gielinor/desktop test:e2e
scripts.test:real-data-boundaries: corepack pnpm --filter @gielinor/desktop exec vitest run src/lib/bridge.test.ts src/App.test.tsx -t "runtime boundaries|Preview data" && node scripts/verify-native-real-boundary.mjs
scripts.test:no-demo-native: corepack pnpm --filter @gielinor/desktop exec vitest run src/lib/bridge.test.ts && node scripts/verify-native-real-boundary.mjs
scripts.test:provenance: corepack pnpm --filter @gielinor/shared-types build && vitest run packages/shared-types/test/provenance.test.ts apps/mcp-server/test/server.integration.test.ts && corepack pnpm --filter @gielinor/desktop exec vitest run src/components/Common.test.tsx
scripts.test:live-data-ui: corepack pnpm --filter @gielinor/desktop exec vitest run src/App.test.tsx src/components/Common.test.tsx src/views/FirstRunView.test.tsx && node scripts/verify-native-real-boundary.mjs
scripts.test:portfolio: corepack pnpm build && vitest run packages/core/test/market-intelligence-service.test.ts -t portfolio
scripts.test:backtesting: corepack pnpm build && vitest run packages/core/test/market-intelligence-service.test.ts -t backtesting
scripts.test:live: corepack pnpm build && node scripts/run-live-tests.mjs all
scripts.test:live:hiscores: corepack pnpm build && node scripts/run-live-tests.mjs hiscores
scripts.test:live:itemdb: corepack pnpm build && node scripts/run-live-tests.mjs itemdb
scripts.test:live:wiki: corepack pnpm build && node scripts/run-live-tests.mjs wiki
scripts.test:live:training: corepack pnpm build && node scripts/run-live-tests.mjs training
scripts.test:live:prices: corepack pnpm build && node scripts/run-live-tests.mjs prices
scripts.test:live:updates: corepack pnpm build && node scripts/run-live-tests.mjs updates
scripts.test:live:market: corepack pnpm build && node scripts/run-live-tests.mjs market
scripts.test:live:ollama: corepack pnpm build && node scripts/run-local-ai-smoke.mjs ollama
scripts.test:live:lm-studio: corepack pnpm build && node scripts/run-local-ai-smoke.mjs lm-studio
